name: Profane Command
oracle_text:
Choose two —
• Target player loses X life.
• Return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
• Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.
• Up to X target creatures gain fear until end of turn. (They can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or black creatures.)
blocked_sentences: • Up to X target creatures gain fear until end of turn. (They can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or black creatures.)

needs.what: a mode-owned target spec (`mode: 3`) whose ceiling is the X announced for the spell (`count: {"x": true}, up_to: true`), so a modal spell's bullet can say "up to X target creatures" and declare those targets only when that mode is chosen
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `count: {"x": true}` is legal on a spell's card-level targets (601.2b announces X before 601.2c), and `mode` is how a Command gives each bullet its own target, but `loader.targets._check_mode_targets` refuses a mode-owned spec whose count is not a literal or "any" ("a mode-owned target's size must be printed"). Dropping `mode` would demand the fear targets whichever two bullets are chosen (and every bullet here owns a target), and `count: "any"` or a literal ceiling is not "up to X"
